chips.title: Assess gameplay alert reliability
chips.summary: Verify the existing alert tests, examine failed delivery and restart behavior, and define acceptance checks for reliable phone alerts.

evidence.message: Repository review found automated screenshot delivery already implemented; assess reliability before choosing further implementation.
Both board files passed the Dias parsers before work began; now verifying tests and delivery failure behavior.
All 54 tests passed. Controlled checks confirmed failed-send deletion, pause discard, missing restart recovery, and duplicate screenshot delivery.
Assessment completed with documented causes, recovery scope, and automated plus live acceptance checks. No completion percentage inferred.

chips.title: Preserve alerts until delivery succeeds
chips.summary: Make pending alerts recoverable across failed sends, pause, and restarts; bound retries and prevent duplicate delivery of completed work.

evidence.message: Reliability assessment found screenshots deleted after failed sends. Implement delivery outcomes and recovery before further live acceptance testing.
